Version 0.78.0

### ✨ New

- Added support for the official Grok runtime, including interaction and permission controls, context usage, and rate limits in Lody.
- A new two-level `@` menu brings files, issues, pull requests, skills, sessions, and commands into one place, including direct references to other sessions.

### 🐛 Fixes and Improvements

- Improved memory pressure checks on macOS and Linux, reducing cases where session startup was incorrectly blocked while the system still had usable resources.
- Restored the zoom-out shortcut in the Electron desktop app.
- Pull request descriptions can now be expanded, and Agent responses use more consistent alignment.
- Fixed multibyte text, including Chinese characters, becoming corrupted when it crossed local connection data chunks.
- Fixed Lody CLI installation through npm or npx failing when dependency versions were not resolved correctly.
- Improved the website landing page's loading speed, asset size, and accessibility.
